channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Lithuania oo xirtay garoomada Vilnius iyo Kaunas, diyaarado NATO-na la kiciyay kaddib drone laga soo diray Belarus
item.description: Diyaaradaha dagaalka NATO ayaa laba jeer xalay la kiciyay kaddib markii diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn oo laga tuhunsan yahay inay ka yimaadeen Belarus ay digniin cireed ka dhaliyeen qaybo badan oo Lithuania ah, garoomada Vilnius iyo Kaunas-na si ku meel gaar ah loo xiray, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today oo soo xigatay idaacadda dowladda Lithuania ee LRT.

item.title: Mareykanka oo si rasmi ah u xaqiijiyay in ciidamadiisu ka baxeen saldhigga Baledogle
item.description: Taliska Mareykanka ee Afrika (AFRICOM) ayaa markii ugu horreysay si rasmi ah u xaqiijiyay in ciidamada Mareykanku ay ka baxeen saldhigga milatari ee Baledogle ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, kaddib markii dhabaha diyaaraduhu xumaaday, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Madaxda hay'adaha amniga oo Muqdisho kulan kula yeeshay hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka
item.description: Taliyeyaasha hay'adaha amniga iyo milatariga Soomaaliya ayaa Muqdisho kulan kula yeeshay hoggaamiyeyaal ka tirsan mucaaradka, kaas oo diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda amni iyo xiisadda siyaasadeed ee dalka, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Tanzania: dakhliga beerta qaranka ee TANAPA oo saddex laab kor ugu kacay shan sano gudahood
item.description: Hay'adda Beeraha Qaranka ee Tanzania (TANAPA) ayaa sheegtay in dakhligeedu uu ka kacay 174 bilyan oo shilin sannadkii 2021/2022 una gaaray 534 bilyan oo shilin sannadkii 2025/2026, iyadoo tirada dalxiisayaashu ay dhaaftay 1.5 milyan.

item.title: Burcad-badeedda xeebaha Soomaaliya oo dib u kordheysa, kalluumeysatada Bander Beyla oo cabanaya
item.description: Weerarrada burcad-badeedda ee xeebaha Soomaaliya ayaa mar kale kordhaya tan iyo April 2026, sida ay sheegtay warbixin uu 10-ka November daabacay Africa Defense Forum, taas oo walaac ku abuurtay amniga maraakiibta ganacsiga ee Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badweynta Hindiya.

item.title: Kenya: Golaha Guurtida oo ka walaacsan diyaargarowga garoonka Kasarani ee AFCON 2027
item.description: Guddiga Shaqada iyo Daryeelka Bulshada ee Golaha Guurtida Kenya ayaa walaac ka muujiyay diyaargarowga garoonka Moi International Sports Centre ee Kasarani, oo loo qorsheeyay inuu martigeliyo ciyaaraha Koobka Qaramada Afrika (AFCON) 2027.

item.title: Ebola: kiisaska Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga Kongo oo dhaafay 11,000, dhimashaduna waa 5,387
item.description: Tirada kiisaska la xaqiijiyay ee cudurka Ebola ee Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga Kongo ayaa gaartay 11,042, iyadoo ugu yaraan 5,387 qof ay u dhinteen, sida ay muujinayaan xogta dowladda ee Talaadadii la shaaciyay.

item.title: Ruushka oo sheegay inuu gobolka Leningrad ku riday 146 diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn
item.description: Guddoomiyaha gobolka Leningrad ee Ruushka, Aleksandr Drozdenko, ayaa sheegay in 146 diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn la soo riday intii lagu jiray weerar Talaadadii ka socday gobolkaas, sida ay werisay wakaaladda wararka ee dowladda Ruushka TASS.

item.title: El Salvador oo sheegtay inay burburisay xarunta kooxda burcadda 400 Mawozo ee Haiti
item.description: Madaxweynaha El Salvador Nayib Bukele ayaa sheegay in ciidamada militariga dalkiisa ay burburiyeen xarunta kooxda 400 Mawozo, oo ka mid ah kooxaha burcadda ugu waaweyn Haiti, weerar dhul iyo cir ah oo lagu qaaday dhisme ku yaalla duleedka caasimadda Port-au-Prince, sida ay werisay BBC.

item.title: Wariyadda Masar Lina Attalah oo maanta maxkamad loo celinayo, iyadoo xabsi u eg
item.description: Wariyadda caanka ah ee Masar Lina Attalah, oo madax u ah warbaahinta madaxa-bannaan ee Mada Masr, ayaa Arbacada maanta ah la horkeenayaa maxkamad dembiyeed oo dib loogu qaadayo dacwad lagu eedeeyay ka shaqeyn shati la'aan iyo faafinta war been ah, sida ay werisay France 24.

item.title: UNCTAD: isbeddelka cimiladu wuxuu dunida ka lumin karaa 10% wax-soosaarkeeda
item.description: Hay'adda Ganacsiga iyo Horumarinta ee Qaramada Midoobay (UNCTAD) ayaa ka digtay in khasaaraha dhaqaale ee isbeddelka cimiladu uu gaari karo qiyaastii 10% wax-soosaarka guud ee adduunka haddii heerkulka dunidu kordho 3 darajo oo Celsius ah, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.

item.title: Eric Zemmour oo ku dhawaaqay inuu mar labaad u tartamayo madaxweynaha Faransiiska
item.description: Qoraaga iyo siyaasiga midigta fog ee Faransiiska, Eric Zemmour, ayaa Talaadadii telefishinka TF1 ka xaqiijiyay inuu musharax ka noqonayo doorashada madaxweynaha ee sannadka soo socda, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera oo ka soo xigatay wakaaladda AFP.

item.title: Ruushka oo dalka ka saaray diblomaasi Moldova ah, jawaab ka ah tallaabo Chisinau qaaday
item.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Ruushka ayaa Talaadadii sheegtay inay dalka ka saartay shaqaale ka tirsan safaaradda Moldova, iyadoo ku tilmaantay jawaab ka ah go'aankii Moldova ee ahaa inay erido shaqaale safaaradda Ruushka ka tirsan, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Erdoğan oo COP31 ku qabtay lix kulan, Turkiga iyo Sacuudigana saxiixeen heshiis koronto
item.description: Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Antalya, oo ay ka socoto shirka cimilada ee COP31, ku qaabilay lix hoggaamiye iyo masuul, waxaana uu goobjoog ka ahaa saxiixa heshiis is-afgarad koronto oo u dhexeeya Turkiga iyo Sacuudi Carabiya.

item.title: Aqalka Wakiillada Mareykanka oo bilaabay codbixin go'aamineysa qaraarka xil ka qaadista Hegseth
item.description: Golaha Wakiillada Mareykanka ayaa Talaadadii bilaabay codbixin habraac ah oo go'aamineysa in qaraarka xil ka qaadista Wasiirka Difaaca Pete Hegseth dib loogu celiyo guddi ama loo gudbiyo codbixin kama dambays ah, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Gianni Infantino oo laga yaabo in Congress-ka Mareykanka uu u yeero bisha January
item.description: Madaxweynaha FIFA Gianni Infantino ayaa laga yaabaa in toddobaadyada soo socda, ugu dambeyn bisha January, uu waajib ku noqdo inuu ka jawaabo amarro yeedhid ah oo uu soo saaro Congress-ka Mareykanka, sida uu werinayo wargeyska Ingiriiska ee The Telegraph.

item.title: Ciidamada UNIFIL oo rasaas lagu furay intii ay ku sugnaayeen roondo koonfurta Lubnaan
item.description: Ciidamada nabad-ilaalinta Qaramada Midoobay ee Lubnaan (UNIFIL) ayaa Talaadadii sheegay in qiyaastii 12 xabbadood lagu riday mid ka mid ah kooxahooda roondada ku jiray meel u dhow Wadi Jilu oo ka tirsan degmada Tyre, iyagoo aan magacaabin cidda ka dambeysay.

item.title: Tanzania oo sheegtay inay 5-tii sano ee la soo dhaafay 604.6 bilyan oo shilin ku dhistay 676 dugsi
item.description: Ku-xigeenka Wasiirka Dowlaha ee Maamulka Gobollada iyo Dowladaha Hoose ee Tanzania, Dr Festo Dugange, ayaa sheegay in dowladdu ku bixisay 604.6 bilyan oo shilin dhismaha 676 dugsi oo cusub iyo 34,464 musqulood, sida uu werisay wargeyska dowladda ee Daily News.

item.title: Askari ka tirsan ciidamada Mareykanka oo Ingiriiska lagu xiray, looguna tuhmay basaasnimo Ruushka
item.description: Booliska la-dagaallanka argagixisada ee London ayaa sheegay in askari 41 jir ah oo ka tirsan ciidamada Mareykanka lagu xiray meel u dhow magaalada Gloucester, iyadoo looga shakisan yahay inuu ku xadgudbay sharciga amniga qaranka ee la xiriira Ruushka.

item.title: Lewis Hamilton oo booqday xuduudda Masar iyo Gaza si uu u arko gargaarka bini'aadannimada
item.description: Darawalka Formula 1 ee 7 jeer horyaalka adduunka ku guuleystay, Lewis Hamilton, ayaa Talaadadii booqday magaalada El Arish ee Masar iyo marinka Rafah, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay shaqaalaha gargaarka ee loo diyaarinayo Marinka Gaza.

item.title: Aurélien Tchouaméni oo dhaawac awgiis uga baxay xulka Faransiiska
item.description: Khadka dhexe ee Real Madrid, Aurélien Tchouaméni, ayaa ka tagaya xerada xulka Faransiiska kadib dhaawac uu ka gaaray agagaarka gumaarka, mana ciyaari doono kulamada Talyaaniga iyo Turkiga ee UEFA Nations League, sida ay wariyeen RMC Sport iyo L'Équipe.

item.title: Maamulka Trump oo soo jeediyay xeer ka saari kara 6.3 milyan oo qof barnaamijka gargaarka cuntada
item.description: Wasaaradda Beeraha Mareykanka (USDA) ayaa Talaadadii daabacday xeer la soo jeediyay oo meesha ka saaraya u-qalmitaanka tooska ah ee barnaamijka SNAP, taasoo sida ay werisay Al Jazeera ka saari karta qiyaastii 6.3 milyan oo qof.

item.title: Kirk Cousins oo dib ugu laabtay Minnesota Vikings, Raiders-na jagada waxay siiyeen Fernando Mendoza
item.description: Kooxda Minnesota Vikings ayaa Kirk Cousins, oo ah quarterback 38 jir ah, ka heshay kooxda Las Vegas Raiders iyagoo bixinaya doorashada wareegga 3-aad ee 2027, sida ay wariyeen The Athletic iyo The Guardian.

item.title: Jim Jordan oo loo doortay hoggaamiyaha Jamhuuriga ee Aqalka Wakiilada Mareykanka, kadib lumintii aqlabiyadda
item.description: Xildhibaannada Jamhuuriga ee Aqalka Wakiilada Mareykanka ayaa cod qarsoodi ah ku doortay Jim Jordan, oo ka socda gobolka Ohio kuna dhow Madaxweyne Donald Trump, si uu u beddelo Mike Johnson, toddobaad kadib markii xisbigu lumiyay aqlabiyadda doorashooyinkii xilliga dhexe.

item.title: Xeer-ilaalinta Mareykanka: hoggaamiye Kataib Hezbollah ah oo xabsi New York ka hagay qorshe weerar saldhig Ingiriis
item.description: Dacwad cusub oo ay xeer-ilaalinta federaalka Mareykanka soo saartay ayaa lagu eedeeyay Mohammad Dawood Al-Saadi, oo haysta dhalashada Iran iyo Ciraaq, inuu isagoo xabsi ku jira New York hagay qorshe fashilmay oo lagu doonayay in lagu weeraro saldhigga ciidamada cirka ee RAF Fairford ee Ingiriiska.

item.title: Wasiirka Dowladaha Hoose ee Uganda oo amar ku bixiyay xarigga saraakiil ka tirsan degmada Ibanda
item.description: Wasiirka Dowladaha Hoose ee Uganda, Balaam Barugahara, ayaa amar ku bixiyay in la xiro lagana joojiyo shaqada qaar ka mid ah saraakiisha dowladda hoose ee degmada Ibanda, kuwaas oo lagu eedeeyay musuqmaasuq, maamul xumo lacagaha dadweynaha iyo xadgudub xilka, sida ay werisay Nile Post.

item.title: Ingiriiska oo sheegay in habka dowladda ku-meel-gaarka ah uu wiiqay is-afgaradka siyaasadeed ee Koonfur Suudaan
item.description: Ku-xigeenka Ergayga Joogtada ah ee Ingiriiska ee Qaramada Midoobay, Kate Foster, ayaa shir Golaha Ammaanka ee New York ka sheegay in habka cusub ee dowladda ku-meel-gaarka ah uu sii wiiqay is-afgaradka siyaasadeed, iyadoo qodobo muhiim ah oo heshiiska nabadda ee 2018 aan weli la fulin, sida ay werisay Eye Radio.

item.title: Rabshado ka dhacay Bangladesh kadib markii taageerayaasha Sheikh Hasina ay dibadbax sameeyeen
item.description: Booliska Bangladesh ayaa gaas ilmeysiiye iyo rasaas caag ah ku kala eryay taageerayaasha ra'iisul wasaarihii xilka laga tuuray Sheikh Hasina, kuwaas oo dalbanaya inay dalka dib ugu soo laabato, sida ay werisay BBC.

item.title: Von der Leyen oo 50 milyan oo yuuro u ballan qaaday Bulgaria iyo Romania kadib weerarrada Badda Madow
item.description: Madaxweynaha Guddiga Midowga Yurub, Ursula von der Leyen, ayaa ballan qaaday 50 milyan oo yuuro si loo dedejiyo xarun wadaag ah oo amniga badda oo ay Bulgaria iyo Romania ka hirgelinayaan Badda Madow, kadib weerarro diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn lagu qaaday maraakiib xamuul.

item.title: Uganda oo higsaneysa inay sannadkii soo saarto 210 milyan oo lammaane galoofyada caafimaadka
item.description: Wasiirka Dowlaha ee Warshadaha Uganda, David Bahati, ayaa xariga ka jaray khadka 2-aad ee wax-soo-saarka warshadda East African Medical Vitals ee Namanve, taasoo lagu wado inay awoodda sannadlaha ah ka qaaddo qiyaastii 80 milyan ilaa 210 milyan oo lammaane, sida ay werisay Nile Post.
